title: Amazon Web Services
subtitle: Managed building blocks for networking, compute, storage and operations.

tiles.label: Route 53
tiles.says: Route 53 resolves names and routes by health and policy.
tiles.detail: Managed DNS with alias records and failover keeps domains reliable.

tiles.label: CloudFront
tiles.says: CloudFront caches content near users with origin access control.
tiles.detail: Edge caching cuts latency and keeps S3 origins private.

tiles.label: Load balancers
tiles.says: Application load balancers route by host and path.
tiles.detail: Managed TLS and health checks spread traffic across availability zones.

tiles.label: VPC & subnets
tiles.says: VPCs separate public and private subnets.
tiles.detail: Private subnets with NAT gateways give outbound access with no inbound exposure.

tiles.label: EC2
tiles.says: EC2 runs workloads on right-sized instances.
tiles.detail: Auto scaling matches capacity to demand, so you pay for what you use.

tiles.label: S3
tiles.says: S3 stores objects with eleven nines of durability.
tiles.detail: Lifecycle rules, versioning and encryption make cheap, safe storage.

tiles.label: IAM
tiles.says: IAM roles grant least-privilege access without long-lived keys.
tiles.detail: Temporary credentials and policies reduce breach impact.

tiles.label: Systems Manager
tiles.says: Session Manager and Parameter Store replace SSH keys and config files.
tiles.detail: Audited shell access and encrypted parameters improve security.

tiles.label: CloudWatch
tiles.says: CloudWatch collects metrics, logs and alarms.
tiles.detail: Native signals from every service drive dashboards and automated response.

declarations: Private subnets by default; expose only what is needed.
